i0.png.text: Today I'll be building and testing a cross-platform mobile game just by using my voice. This is Hollowmere, a fantasy RPG I built with Devin beforehand. It runs on iOS, Android and the web from one Expo codebase, and the companion walking beside you, Eira, is live on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 API. You talk, she answers, and the game carries out what you said.

chunks.text: Today I'll be building and testing a cross-platform
mobile game just by using my voice.
This is Hollowmere,
a fantasy RPG I built with Devin beforehand.
It runs on iOS,
Android and the web from one Expo codebase,
and the companion walking beside you,
Eira, is live on OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 API.
You talk, she answers,
and the game carries out what you said.

i1.png.text: You can cut her off mid-sentence, send her somewhere else, and even change how she talks.

chunks.text: You can cut her off mid-sentence,
send her somewhere else,
and even change how she talks.

i2.png.text: Now I'll add a feature to the game with Devin Voice, by talking to Devin the same way. Devin Voice uses ChatGPT voice under the hood.

chunks.text: Now I'll add a feature to the game
with Devin Voice,

Devin Voice uses ChatGPT voice under the hood.

i3.png.text: Then I checked the feature myself, live, on the web build. Eira is on GPT-Live-1, and I ask her to mark the barrow.

chunks.text: Then I checked the feature myself,
live, on the web build.
Eira is on GPT-Live-1,
and I ask her to mark the barrow.

i4.png.text: The tool fires. A beam of light goes up across the valley, a pin lands on the compass, and clear the marker takes it away. On the iPhone simulator, Devin saw the same beam and pin, at about one frame a minute on software rendering. The Android emulator ran at about one frame a second. No physical devices were tested.
